Packet G pure slice: planDraftSnapshot checks the proposed base revision against the supplied current revision, validates the existing node snapshot, and returns a candidate without writes. Table tests cover stable node IDs, opaque unknown content and style, and local-only undo with a newer peer edit. The eventual writer must still compare and write atomically. This leaves E0 and its manual phase gate open.

UPDATE 2026-11-11 (page_versions + atomic writer, dark): migration 20270346043000 adds public.page_versions (immutable tree per publish, service role only), pages.published_version_id, publish_page_version() (locks the page, takes the next revision, inserts the version, swaps the pointer, dual-writes published_data, one transaction) and revert_page_to_version() (one pointer swap). lib/page-editor/versions.ts wraps them and lists/reads versions; publishPage takes the versioned path only when EDITOR_CANVAS is on, and revertPageToVersion is the matching action. Order: merge, then apply the SQL in Frequency Community and record the ledger row, then the switch may go on. Remaining: the version-history panel (BLD-403), dropping published_data from the read path after a release, the bundle-byte instrument, the manual phase gate.

UPDATE 2026-11-16 (PROG-E0B, the bundle-byte instrument, advisory): scripts/check-editor-bundle-bytes.mjs reads the built artifact for the CRDT runtime and reports any route outside /pages/canvas that names a chunk carrying it, plus the editor and lazy byte counts. It runs last in postbuild and cannot fail a build. It has NOT read a real artifact yet; arming it (--strict, blocking) needs one production build log first and is still owed here.

PREMISE CORRECTIONS, re-tested against the tree and the live database on 2026-11-16:
- The version-history panel (BLD-403) is NOT still owed. /pages/canvas?page=<slug> mounts HistoryPanel fed by listPageVersions; the panel previews a version, restores it whole or by section into the draft, publishes, and reverts through revertPageToVersion. Staff only, behind EDITOR_CANVAS. Its probe passes. Not exercised in a browser because the switch is off.
- Migration 20270346043000 IS applied: public.page_versions and pages.published_version_id exist in Frequency Community.
- render_path_space_profile and render_path_email are ON in production (set 2026-10-20). render_path_spotlight, render_path_site and render_path_marketing are off. Earlier notes here that say do not turn the Space switch on yet are out of date.
- The status marks in docs/EDITOR-E0.md section 8 are stale for tasks 5, 6, 9, 12, 13, 14, 15 and 18. The list below replaces them.

SECTION 8, TRUE STATUS 2026-11-16 (tasks 1, 2, 3, 8, 10, 11 were already done):
- 4, round-trip half: PARTLY. check:node-document-safety (LIVE-871) is in the CI guards and protects the entity node upgrade over the census. Open: the raw legacy write round trip and the Puck catalog, which the gate itself says it does not claim. Next: add a legacy save, load, save fixture arm to that gate.
- 5: DONE. Migration merged and applied (see above).
- 6: DONE in code, dark. publishPage takes the versioned path behind EDITOR_CANVAS, revertPageToVersion exists, the history panel is mounted. Open: its gate (publish, revert, publish on a real page) has not been run; it needs EDITOR_CANVAS on in a preview.
- 7: OPEN, and correctly so. published_data is still read by lib/page-editor/data.ts, app/page.tsx, the edit page, lib/page-editor/versions.ts and lib/library/usage.ts. Next: turn EDITOR_CANVAS on, let one release publish through the pointer, then move getPublishedPage to read through published_version_id. No schema drop before that.
- 9: DONE (LIVE-119). parseEntityLayout calls upgradeLayout.
- 12, edit half: DONE for Space, Spotlight, email and member surfaces (LIVE-1004 to LIVE-1064): the node store, LiveNodeGrid, NodePageBuilder, the canvas model, the email canvas and the owner preview all run on nodes behind their render_path switch. Open: the marketing and site surfaces, and the importer writing member node layouts.
- 13, email path: DONE on the read side. lib/email-studio/render.ts renders through upgradeLayout per placement, and render_path_email is on. Not re-checked here: that the three crons send unchanged output.
- 14: DONE for Space, Spotlight, email, nurture and member writers (LIVE-1003, 1052, 1057, 1061, 1062). Open: the importer and the AI paths sending nodes, and the site and marketing writers.
- 15: OPEN. scripts/upgrade-entity-layouts.mts is landed (dry run by default, backup before --apply) and has not been run. Its precondition (the Space switch on) is now met. Next: the owner runs the dry run and reads the per-row diff.
- 16+17: OPEN, nothing built. public.app_instances does not exist and lib/apps/instances.ts does not exist. Next: one additive create-table migration with the writer on the publish path in the same PR (needs a migration, so an owner decision).
- 18, CRDT: built and dark. Open: two real browsers converging on a live socket (the RUNBOOKS gate), the instrument reading a real artifact and then being armed, and the choice on storing Yjs state in the draft row.

UPDATE 2026-11-16 (PROG-E0C, the bundle-byte gate is armed): the production build of main printed check:editor-bundle-bytes green on a real artifact (633 routes read, /(main)/pages/canvas/page 116.6 KB, no route outside the editor named), so postbuild now runs it blocking, as the seventh artifact gate. A route outside /pages/canvas that names a chunk carrying yjs or y-prosemirror fails the build (exit 1); an artifact the gate cannot read fails it too (exit 79), including a new arm for manifests whose chunk names resolve to nothing on disk. This closes the 'instrument reading a real artifact and then being armed' item under task 18. Not yet seen: this blocking spelling on a real build; the first build after merge is that reading.
STILL OPEN on this row after PROG-E0C:

- Tasks 16+17: the app_instances migration. public.app_instances and lib/apps/instances.ts do not exist; it needs one additive migration with the writer in the same PR, which is an owner decision.
- Task 18: the two-browser co-edit test. Two real browsers converging on a live socket (the RUNBOOKS gate for EDITOR_COLLAB) has not been run.
- Unchanged from the list above: tasks 4 (legacy round trip), 6 (publish, revert, publish on a real page), 7 (published_data read path), the open halves of 12 and 14, the choice on storing Yjs state in the draft row, and the manual phase gate.

UPDATE 2026-11-18 (tasks 16+17, app_instances, owner approved the additive migration 2026-11-18): migration 20270346140000_app_instances.sql re-creates public.app_instances, service role only (RLS on, no policy, anon and authenticated revoked), keyed (space_id, surface_type, surface_ref, id) because node ids are deterministic per placement and repeat across Spaces; surface_type takes the four architecture surfaces; no config, style_override or status columns (content and style live on the node). The writer ships with it: lib/apps/instances.ts syncInstancesForSurface reconciles the placed nodes of a node-stored layout (bench excluded, legacy documents skipped) and publishSpaceProfileLayout calls it after a successful publish, best effort, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS. Tests: lib/apps/instances.test.ts, supabase/tests/app_instances.test.sql. MIGRATION UNAPPLIED: the table does not exist in Frequency Community; scripts/check-schema-contract.mjs carries one dated ALLOWLIST entry for it until types are regenerated. Order: policy-only readiness PR, merge, apply, regenerate lib/database.types.ts and drop the ALLOWLIST entry; EDITOR_CANVAS must not be turned on before the apply. Tasks 16+17 are done in code only; their consequence (publishing writes N rows whose id is the node id) is unproven until a publish runs against the applied table. Row stays open.

UPDATE 2026-11-23 (post-apply, tasks 16+17): migration 20270346140000 is APPLIED. It is recorded in schema_migrations in Frequency Community and public.app_instances exists (read from the live project on 2026-11-23). This supersedes MIGRATION UNAPPLIED in the 2026-11-18 note. Unchanged: task 15 (the backfill dry run), task 18 (two browsers on a live socket), tasks 4, 6 and 7, the open halves of 12 and 14, the choice on storing Yjs state in the draft row, and the manual phase gate.
